definitions.explanation: Used in questions and conditional sentences to mean 'anything at all.'
Used adverbially before an adjective or verb to say that something feels a certain way without the speaker being able to name the cause.

examples.japanese: {何|なに}か⟦{食|た}べたい→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
{何|なに}か⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ありますか→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{何|なに}か⟦あったら→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please contact me if anything happens.

examples.japanese: {何|なに}か⟦{手伝|てつだ}いましょうか→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧。
examples.english: Can I help you with something?

examples.japanese: {何|なに}か⟦{飲|の}みますか→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: Would you like something to drink?

examples.notes: Adverbial use: 何か modifies 変, not a noun

examples.japanese: {何|なに}か⟦{欲|ほ}しい→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧⟦もの→もの：02259_mono⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧？
{何|なに}か⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あったら→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: If there's anything you don't understand, ask me.

examples.japanese: {何|なに}かご⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ありますか→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{何|なに}か⟦{寂|さび}しい→寂しい：00880_sabishii⟧⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
USAGE: {何|なに}か points at a thing without identifying it. In statements it is "something"; in questions and conditionals it is "anything". Before an adjective it works adverbially and means "somehow".

NO PARTICLE AFTER IT:
{何|なに}か normally drops the ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ or ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ that its grammatical role would call for: {何|なに}か⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧, not {何|なに}か⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧. Other particles do attach: {何|なに}か⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (use it for something).

FUNCTIONS:
1. Something (statement): {何|なに}か⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧ (I heard something)
2. Anything (question or conditional): {何|なに}か⟦あったら→ある：00006_aru⟧ (if anything happens)
3. Somehow (adverbial, before an adjective or a feeling): {何|なに}か⟦{変|へん}→変：01124_hen⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ (something feels off)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {何|なに}か⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ (to drink something)
- {何|なに}か⟦{用|よう}→用：01114_you⟧⟦ですか→だ：09496_da⟧ (Can I help you? / Do you need something?)
- {何|なに}か⟦{手伝|てつだ}おう→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ (Shall I help with something?)

SPOKEN VARIANT:
⟦なんか→なんか：05309_nanka⟧ is the casual contraction. It covers the same ground but also works as a filler word and as a dismissive "things like", so it is not a free substitute in careful speech.

THE か SERIES:
- ⟦{誰|だれ}か→誰か：02912_dareka⟧ (someone)
- ⟦どこか→どこか：02361_dokoka⟧ (somewhere)
- ⟦いつか→いつか：01809_itsuka⟧ (sometime)
Each pairs with a ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ form that requires a negative: ⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧ (nothing at all).
